theme.description: High-end developer portfolio. Swiss Brutalist & High-Contrast mixed with subtle Retro-Futurism. Objective, rigid, functional, using striking monochrome elements with sharp electric blue accents.

rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for all Headings > 32px.
Labels, overlines, and tags MUST use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, and wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Body text should use leading-relaxed for optimal readability.

spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Tension is created through asymmetry and empty space.
spacing.grid_rules: Use visible grid lines (border-white/10) for technical sections like Skills. For Bento grids, ensure there is breathing room (gap-8).

surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-950), 1px solid border (border-white/10), 0px or 4px max border-radius. No soft shadows. Use sharp inner contrasts.
surfaces.nav: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) and a delicate 1px bottom border (border-white/10).
surfaces.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary CTA is solid white text on primary blue bg. Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px white/20 border and hover:bg-white/10.

projects.title: Eclipse IDE Development
projects.description: Developed Eclipse-based IDE for Bosch using JavaScript and RCP, improving data processing efficiency by 35%.

global.animations: Framer Motion. Use subtle fade-in-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) and stagger transitions for grid items.

hero_section.layout: Massive typography, left-aligned or asymmetric. Introduce tension by having empty space on the right. No photo in the hero.
components: Subtitle: 'Senior Software Engineer | Java & Spring Boot'
CTA Buttons: 'View My Work', 'Get In Touch' (Primary and Secondary styles).

about_section.layout: 2-column asymmetric grid (md:grid-cols-12). Profile image takes col-span-4, bio text takes col-span-7 with col-start-6.
about_section.image_treatment: Grayscale profile image by default, transitions to color on hover. Hard 0px border-radius, thin border-white/10 frame.

skills_section.layout: Technical Grid (Bento style). Use border-collapse on the parent and border-white/10 on items to expose the grid skeleton.
skills_section.tags: Use small monospace tags (JetBrains Mono) for individual skills with a very subtle bg-white/5 background.

projects_section.layout: Vertical stack of large cards or a sticky scroll section.
projects_section.card_style: Image on top/side with a max-h-[40vh] to keep it sleek. Overlay tech stack as monospace tags. The title should be large and expressive.

contact_section.layout: Minimalist bento layout. Left side: Direct contact info (Email, Phone, Location). Right side: Contact form.
contact_section.form_components: Use custom-styled Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Give them sharp edges (rounded-none), bg-transparent, and border-white/20. Focus states should have a sharp blue ring (ring-blue-600).

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute `yarn add lenis framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`
Install Google Fonts in index.css: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare) or similar if unavailable, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Do NOT use Inter for any headings.
Implement a deep dark mode. Set body background to black (#000000) and text to white (#FFFFFF).
Build the UI completely with HTML/Tailwind for structural components, avoiding overly-heavy Shadcn components for marketing layouts (except the Contact Form where Shadcn is preferred).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs).
Ensure the hero section does not use the profile image. Place the profile image in the About section.
Create a noise/grain texture overlay for the whole page using a subtle CSS mix-blend-mode overlay to kill digital flatness.
